_strawberry.hill_: The sergeant gave Jakub "Hollow" Hill a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 4 or any other.
Jakub "Hollow" Hill tipped water from a boot and a small beetle climbed out. At least one passenger had enjoyed the crossing.

Henrik Hunted had Jakub "Hollow" Hill of the Hegemony in the sights at the Hanging Bridge for a long second. Jakub "Hollow" Hill was lighting a pipe. Henrik Hunted let the match burn all the way down.
pyyro.2030: Oskar "Mud" Pyyro left a teacher who said he would amount to nothing behind in Port Abel and came up the line with a pressed cornflower. The men noticed at once that he collects shell fuses.
Oskar "Mud" Pyyro sharpened a pencil carefully and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway.
A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Oskar "Mud" Pyyro's bunk. He has named it Napoleon.
samhatespeace: The new stretcher bearer is Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac, once a ferryman from Belmonte. The corporal asked if a ferryman was any use in a trench. Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac said he would find out.
Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac, volunteer number 81, received the First Wave ribbon. The quartermaster pronounced the name wrong; he corrected it for the record.
Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac tried to describe the smell of Belmonte and got as far as the bakery. Then the ration cart arrived.

During a lull at Sorrow Copse, Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac called across from the Concord line. Roland Monster answered from the Hegemony side with a convincing imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet. Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise.
Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac held the mirror while Rafael "Button" Superfeisty shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.
Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F9. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Marek Ditrih of the Hegemony (@ditrih_88).
